masthead.purpose: Home title only. Archivo wdth 62, 800, uppercase.

agora.purpose: The one next step, with the live dot. Condensed caps, 36px rising to 60px.

headline.purpose: Program (album) title and section titles. All h1-h3 take wdth 62, 800, uppercase.

body.purpose: Normal-width Archivo for text, fields, names and buttons.

label.purpose: Column heads, badges and captions; 12px bold uppercase, tabular numerals for years and times.

brand.purpose: Wordmark beside the logo mark in the masthead; condensed caps, about 26px.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The member options menu, the only floating surface.

shadows.name: rule-box
shadows.purpose: Boxes, controls and the grid are separated by ruled lines, not shadows.

shadows.name: rule-section
shadows.purpose: Masthead bottom rule and section top rules.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: A done mark landing in the grid.

motion.name: band-in
motion.value: 0.55s ease-print, 70ms stagger; scaleX 0 to 1 from left

motion.name: tally
motion.value: 2s ease-out infinite; scale 1 to 2.2, opacity 0.7 to 0
motion.purpose: Live dot pulse beside the AGORA line.

motion.name: roulette
motion.purpose: Cover tape decelerating onto the winner; winner scales to 1.05, others dim to 35% greyscale over 0.5s.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover fill shifts on buttons and tiles.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations collapse to 0.01ms; roulette jumps to result

motion.name: sound
motion.value: Web Audio, no files; master gain 0.6 through a compressor limiter; off by default, choice persisted
motion.purpose: Pen click, teleprinter tick and noise tape, stamp thud for vote and ready, two-note join chime, low square buzz on error, stamp plus bell chord on lock.

components.name: Logo and Masthead
components.description: Newspaper strip: logo mark with wordmark, today's date, and an icon-only sound toggle, closed with a 3px ink rule.
components.html: Disco da VezDomingo, 18 de outubro
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--foreground); padding-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-masthead-id { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; min-width: 0; } .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-logo-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; } .ds-brand { font-size: 26.4px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; font-stretch: 62%; } .ds-date { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-sound { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid var(--foreground); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-sound:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-sound:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-agora { display: grid; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-agora-line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin: 0; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 0.92; font-stretch: 62%; } .ds-agora-lead { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-live { position: relative; display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 0.7em; height: 0.7em; margin-top: 0.12em; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--live); } .ds-live::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; border: 2px solid var(--live); animation: ds-tally 2s ease-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-tally { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.7; } to { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 0; } } .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1.5px solid var(--foreground); box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-chip.ds-you { background: var(--you); color: var(--you-ink); } .ds-chip-mark { position: absolute; right: -6px; bottom: -6px; width: 16px; height: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1.5px solid var(--foreground); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--card); } .ds-chip-done { background: var(--foreground); } .ds-chip-pending { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--foreground) 0 1.5px, var(--card) 1.5px 5px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Six-Slot Band
components.description: Six-slot strip with a halftone overprint: your blue slot first, five ink slots; prints in left to right on Home.
components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 6px; height: 20px; } .ds-band span { background: var(--foreground); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-band-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-band span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 70ms; } .ds-band span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 140ms; } .ds-band span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 210ms; } .ds-band span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 280ms; } .ds-band span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 350ms; } .ds-band::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0 0 0 / 0.32) 0 1.1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 5px 5px; mix-blend-mode: multiply; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-band-in { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-band span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The group's night is one printed page of TV listings. Every person is a row, every step is a time slot, and the drawn album is the prime-time program. The surface is cool newsprint with a faint paper grain, set in near-black ink, divided by 1.5px rules. Nothing is lit, glassy or glowing; the page is read, not watched.

The mood is flat, printed, structural and quick to scan. Colour is rationed to meaning: one blue marks you (your row, your chip, your slot in the band), a red dot means "live, do this now", and everyone and everything else is ink on paper. State is read from shape, not hue, so the page works in a glance and in greyscale. Sound completes the print metaphor: pen clicks, teleprinter ticks, a stamp thud and a short programme-opening chime, all synthesized with Web Audio. Sound is off by default; the masthead icon toggle turns it on and the choice is remembered.

The previous valve-radio world was rejected as too decorative; its teal, amber, brass, glass and radio imagery do not return.
keyCharacteristics: Newsprint paper, near-black ink, 1.5px ruled boxes, thick top rule on program boxes.
One accent, blue, for "you" only, plus the red live dot.
One typeface, Archivo Variable; width axis does the work of a second family.
State as shape: filled square, hatched square, dash.
Flat depth; one soft shadow, on the popover menu only.
Logo: ink square, paper disc with groove ring, one Live Red corner dot; never blue.

rules.name: The One-Accent-Is-You Rule
rules.body: The only colour is the blue that means "you", plus the red live dot. Other people are paper and ink; if a colour does not mark you or the one live step, it is ink or paper.

rules.name: The State-Is-Shape Rule
rules.body: Done, waiting and not-applicable are a filled square, a hatched square and a dash. Never encode state in hue, and keep the legend visible under any grid that uses the marks.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo Variable only. Contrast comes from width (62% vs 100%), weight and case, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Flat-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. If something needs separating, add a rule; the popover is the only exception.

rules.name: The No-Decoration-Without-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Grain is paper, halftone is the print band, rules separate; nothing else ornamental.

rules.name: The Red-Dot-Is-Live Rule
rules.body: The logo dot is the same Live Red as the AGORA dot, and the mark never takes You Blue or any other colour.

dos: Do keep the page paper, ink and rules, and let the blue "you" be the only colour field.
Do show state with the filled, hatched and dash marks, and keep the legend under the grid.
Do set h1-h3 and the AGORA line in Archivo at wdth 62, weight 800, uppercase, line-height about 0.9; set everything else at normal width.
Do use 1.5px ink borders, 4px corners, and 0 radius with a 6px top rule for program boxes.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and rows at 56px.
Do put light ink (you-ink) on You Blue fills.
Do keep the live red to the dot, the needle tip and the caret, and reserve motion for stamps, band entrances, the pulse and the roulette.

Do keep the Pessoas menu, invite copy, profile and leader claim to the pre-round state; show a read-only grid while choosing and voting, and omit it on the draw screen so the content spans the full width.
donts: Don't reintroduce the radio world: no teal, amber, brass, glass, blur, dials or valve imagery.
Don't give other people their own colours: per-person channel colours were tried and rejected.
Don't add decoration with no job (the No-Decoration-Without-a-Job Rule): grain is paper, halftone is the print band, rules separate; nothing else ornamental.
Don't use neon, glow, gradients as surfaces, or dark-mode music-app styling.
Don't encode state or status in hue, or colour anything that is not you or the live step.
Don't add a second typeface or fake a display face with fills or shadows.
Don't lift surfaces with shadows; the popover shadow is the only one.
Don't put a decorative eyebrow or kicker above headings; the "Agora:" lead belongs to the one-step line, not to section titles.
